primary_measurements.citation: Kudla G, Murray AW, Tollervey D, Plotkin JB. Science 2009.
primary_measurements.note: The Science SOM documents the experiment but does not contain the complete per-construct sequence-expression table.

primary_table.citation: Supek F, Smuc T. Genetics 2010, File S2, Kudla et al. GFP dataset and tagged dataset.

independent_derivative_copy.citation: Fernandes A, Vinga S. PLOS ONE 2016, S1 Software.

data_rules: Preserve every source column and every source row in the two GFP sheets.
Treat seqId as the construct key; never renumber from a literature sample count.
Group exact duplicate CDS for every future split; do not randomly separate identical CDS across train and evaluation.
Retain all 154 measurement rows while disclosing 150 unique exact CDS and four duplicate groups.
Do not impute a tagged nucleotide sequence: File S2 supplies tagged MFE, codon frequencies and expression, not tagged sequenceWithUtr.
Do not digitize figures or infer unobserved expression values.
Do not read or evaluate the pre-existing functional untouched partition.
This recovery protocol does not fit a model, authorize generator training, or claim RK-G1, OOD, untouched, time-matched or SOTA completion.
